scripts.gate: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test

simple-git-hooks.pre-push: if [ ! -f scripts/cartography/cli.ts ]; then echo 'pre-push: this branch has no scripts/cartography, map not checked'; exit 0; fi; node scripts/cartography/cli.ts --write && git diff --exit-code HEAD -- docs/agents/cartography.md || { echo 'pre-push: docs/agents/cartography.md differs from the commit; commit the regenerated map, then push again' >&2; exit 1; }
